q: The Perron-Frobenius theorem applies to non-negative irreducible matrices and states that:
opts: There is a unique largest real eigenvalue (Perron root) with a positive eigenvector
All eigenvalues have the same modulus
exp: Perron-Frobenius: a positive (irreducible non-negative) matrix has a simple largest positive eigenvalue ρ (Perron root) with a unique positive eigenvector. Critical in Markov chains and dynamical systems.
